def _set_encoding_attrs(self, variable, src_var_md, dtype):
        """ Sets de-/encoding attributes for a data variable from its metadata, falling back to current values. """
        self.scale_factors[variable] = src_var_md.get('scale_factor', self.scale_factors.get(variable, 1))
        self.offsets[variable] = src_var_md.get('add_offset', self.offsets.get(variable, 0))
        self.nodatavals[variable] = src_var_md.get('_FillValue', self.nodatavals.get(variable, 127))
        self.dtypes[variable] = self.dtypes.get(variable, dtype)
